article.linkText: Washington and Toronto meet in conference showdown
article.story: Toronto Raptors (1-0, fourth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Washington Wizards (1-0, fifth in the Eastern Conference) Washington; Friday, 7 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Washington hosts Toronto in a matchup of Eastern Conference teams. Washington went 17-65 overall, 11-41 in Eastern Conference play and 11-30 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Wizards averaged 112.9 points per game while allowing opponents to score 124.9 last season. Toronto finished 46-36 overall and 33-19 in Eastern Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Raptors allowed opponents to score 111.8 points per game and shoot 46.7% from the field last season. INJURIES: Wizards: AJ Dybantsa: out (ankle), Tristan Vukcevic: out (hip), Jamir Watkins: out for season (acl). Raptors: Nate Bittle: out (foot). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
